description: Apply a declarative JSON deployment manifest (ce-deploy.json) to Code Engine. For each app in the manifest, creates it if missing or updates it (PATCH) if it exists — an idempotent, GitOps-style apply. Supports env vars, scaling, ports, and registry secrets. Use dry_run to preview the plan without making changes.

dry_run.description: Preview the create/update plan without applying it (default: false).

manifest_path.description: Path to a ce-deploy.json manifest file (default: ce-deploy.json in the current working directory). Ignored if `manifest` is provided.

project_id.description: Override the project_id from the manifest.

name: proc_apply_manifest
